title: UnlockedEnchants
description: Unlocked Enchants was designed to bypass standard Minecraft enchantment restrictions, allowing those with permission to apply, remove, and manage enchantments at levels far exceeding vanilla limits.
body:
![SplashImage](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1e67862f6fec087e21fe7ff230371c446029f6bc_0.webp)
**UnlockedEnchants** is a Paper plugin designed to bypass standard Minecraft enchantment restrictions, allowing players to apply, remove, and manage enchantments at levels far exceeding vanilla limits.


The plugin enables "unsafe" enchanting, which means it ignores standard level caps (e.g., Sharpness V) and item-type restrictions. Its primary features include:

    Maximum Level Expansion: Allows enchantments to reach up to level 255.

    Command-Based Application: Users can apply specific enchantments directly to the item in their main hand via commands.

    Enchantment Removal: Provides functionality to strip specific enchantments or completely clear all enchantments from an item.

    Information Display: Includes a list command to view current enchantments on a held item, often highlighting which levels exceed vanilla maximums.

Command Structure

The plugin operates through the base command /uenchant with several subcommands:

    /uenchant <enchantment> <level>: Applies the specified enchantment at the chosen level (1–255) to the held item.

    /uenchant remove <enchantment>: Removes a specific enchantment from the item.

    /uenchant clear: Completely strips all enchantments from the held item.

    /uenchant list: Displays all enchantments currently on the held item.

    /uenchant help: Shows the command menu and usage instructions.

Technical Details

    Permissions: Access is controlled via the blsmr.uenchant.use permission node.

    Tab Completion: The plugin features intelligent tab-completion for enchantment names and subcommands to improve ease of use.

    Visual Feedback: It uses color-coded messages (e.g., gold for levels above vanilla max, green for successful applications) to provide clear feedback to the user.

    Safety Checks: The plugin verifies that a player is holding an item before attempting to apply or modify enchantments.


As always I was thinking about making a server...and I have one up as a testing grounds....I have been converting and upgrading plugins I was making for the server instead for modrinth. I have a nice sort of unique shops plugin...but I need to work out some final kinks before public release of beta.
